name: I loved ,But I Let Go
original_name: 我曾深爱，但我选择了放手
overview: On their fifth wedding anniversary, Brian Lodge abandons his wife, Linda Grant, and their son, Tim, to spend the day with his childhood sweetheart, Sharon Birch. Heartbroken, Linda takes Tim and leaves. That night, under a relentless downpour, they get into a tragic car accident-one that costs Tim his eye. When Brian returns, begging for forgiveness, Linda gives him a second chance. She can't bear for Tim to lose both his sight and his father.  (Source: DramaBoxdb)
